jobs.title: 白丝芭蕾蛙
jobs.prompt: Create one finished 1:1 square artwork for a humorous milk-frog jigsaw puzzle. The attached reference is for character identity: golden-yellow plump pear-shaped head and torso merging without a neck, cream belly, pale green circular eye rings and centered black pupils, small deadpan mouth, olive-brown hands. Anthropomorphic ADULT cartoon characters only. Campy elegant fashion parody with a slightly sultry theatrical pose, amusing absurdity and a completely straight milk-frog face. Tasteful fully clothed outfit, legs in stockings, no nudity, no explicit sexual content, no humans. No text, logos, signatures, watermark, puzzle grid or borders. Rich scene details and distinct objects in each quadrant help puzzle recognition. Polished painterly storybook-oil illustration, sophisticated light and color; keep the frog's identity clear and make the joke charming. A full-body golden milk frog poses like a flamboyant adult prima ballerina in an elegant old theater rehearsal room. It wears opaque WHITE tights/stockings on gracefully elongated anthropomorphic legs, a tiny cream tutu skirt around the lower belly, pale pink ballet slippers and a small pearl bracelet. One leg lifted in a theatrical graceful ballet pose, one hand delicately arched overhead, other hand on its waist; the round pear-shaped yellow upper body and deadpan green-ringed eyes create the comic contrast. Warm golden afternoon light, faded teal curtains, a large gilded standing mirror at the left reflecting the dance room, pink roses in a porcelain vase, oak parquet floor, scattered sheet music without readable writing. Full-body composition, charming fashion-comedy, not erotic photography. Ivory, dusty rose, sage and warm gold.
